review.name: Gravepeak Behemoth
findings: All twelve original source head/body slices and all 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected independently. Forelegs and hands flatten and stretch during walk, gallop, gallop jump, entrance, attack and recoil. Actual earth strike, breaker, open wound and signature windup turn the forearm into a flattened sheet; strike pulls the front feet below the preview platform. Jaw/cheek shifts relative to crest in recoil and death. Original battle baseline captured but no raw battle slice inspection claimed. Freeze original visible four-support geometry before any repair; independent joint fitting and complete face binding required.

Original twelve source head/body slices and all 216 actual techniques inspected. Forearms flattened during windup, limbs stretched during gait/jump and strike feet sank below platform. Original humanoid joints sit far from the four visible supports. Original independent sole overlay and shoulder/elbow/hip/knee pixel picks inspected before repair. Complete jaw/crest binding, four fitted visible limb chains, coordinated support-aware actions and anatomically placed neck/head pivots preserve the sculpt, UVs/textures, original 21 bone frames/inverses and 164 unaffected curves. Fourteen joints appended with original leg and face nodes retained under legacy prefixes. All twelve candidate raw slices and all 216 candidate actual technique frames inspected and pass. Frozen independent face passes 2040 clip poses plus 468 blends; 1591 full-geometry poses have zero warnings. Final rebuilt source/battle repeat review pending.

Final separate second pass actually inspected all 24 raw source/battle head/body slices, all 32 low/medium production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, all 216 actual equipped-technique frames in twelve lossless native strips and sixteen atlas cells. All pass. Frozen face 2040 clip poses plus 468 blends and full-geometry 1591 poses per asset pass. Twelve anatomical regression tests plus three animation-bank tests and production build pass. Original and final hoof surfaces are tested at 481 times per action, including between keys. Whole-roster and live release pending.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-mythic-014-anatomical-v1-final-techniques
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All nine actual techniques inspected front and side at twelve times on rebuilt battle asset. Complete jaw and crest hold shape, four legs remain connected to the torso, and no strike sinks below the platform. Attack intentionally lifts the left front hoof with three supporting feet; cast and recoil keep four supporting feet.

review.faceCameraCoverage: One armored behemoth head. Expanded camera exposes both tall head horns and nose crest. Brow, muzzle, true side lower jaw, cheek, crest and both horns inspected. Initial frontal lower-face point landed on throat and was rejected before animation probing. Sparse crest/horn patches enlarged on their actual surfaces; arms, body armor and all feet require full motion review.
